summary: Share the existing backup archive writer with a private read-only staged-file reader

compatibility.detail: No CLI, endpoint, record or format change. The private entry is not wired to an operation. Both existing archive versions retain the same writer, framing, ordering and body matching semantics.

schema.detail: No DDL, registry, storage layout or version change. The private reader refuses unsupported or incomplete installed metadata instead of opening a migrating Store.

rules.detail: No signature, chain, checkpoint, retention or admission rule change. A stage with retained claims lacking envelopes refuses without signing or sealing.

replay.detail: No replay, migration, sealing or repair is performed by the private stage reader.

downtime.detail: No service or runtime action is attached to this factoring.

manual.detail: No new command or production backup procedure. Online copy, capacity, lifecycle, CLI and resource qualification remain separate work.

recovery.detail: No recovery behavior change. This factoring is not a live deadline fix or evidence of the reported predecessor-gap cause.
